_note: Canned illustration of the kinds of mistake a model can make without the dictionary. Written by hand for tests and offline runs. It is not the output of a real model and is no evidence about any model.

paragraphs.text: Funds left account 8060BA880 and returned to it through two other accounts within 6.92 days.
The customer's source of funds was verified and found to be legitimate.
The pattern also matches IND99999, the rapid movement of funds between related accounts.
Ownership could not be checked (IND02191 was not assessed).
Overall the case shows clear signs of money laundering.
